cap.untrusted: In Restricted Mode ChangeKeeper still tracks and restores changes, but exclusion and critical-file rules from workspace settings are ignored (only user settings apply).
cap.virtual: ChangeKeeper needs a real file system to take baselines and watch changes.
welcome.noSession:
No guarded session in this workspace.
[Start guarding](command:changekeeper.startSession)

ChangeKeeper takes a baseline of the folder and shows every change made afterwards — by an AI coding agent, a script or you — so you can review it hunk by hunk and roll it back.
welcome.noChanges:
Guarding. No changes since the baseline yet.

When an agent edits files they appear here; click a file to see the diff, expand it to accept or discard hunks.
cfg.autoStart: When to start guarding a folder automatically. `git`: folders inside a git repository (baseline from the index, no copies). `always`: any folder (non-git folders are copied, within limits). `off`: only when you run **New Session**.
cfg.exclude: Extra glob patterns (workspace-relative) that ChangeKeeper never tracks. Critical files are tracked even if excluded or git-ignored. Applies to the next session.
cfg.excludeDefaults: Apply the built-in exclusions (`node_modules`, `dist`, `out`, `build`, caches, logs…). Turn off if your source lives in one of those folders. Applies to the next session.
cfg.criticalGlobs: Extra glob patterns flagged as critical (shown first, warning icon). Built-in: migrations, SQL, CI workflows, Dockerfiles, `.env*`, auth/security folders, package manifests and lock files, `.vscode`, `.claude`, `.cursor`. Applies to the next session.
cfg.maxFileSizeKB: Files larger than this (KB) are recorded but not diffed or copied. Applies to the next session.
cfg.burstThreshold: When more than this many *new* files change within 5 seconds (npm install, build, checkout), ChangeKeeper pauses new files and asks what to do. Applies to the next session.
cfg.retentionDays: Closed sessions (and their baselines) are kept for this many days. The running session is never deleted.
cfg.retentionMaxMB: Maximum disk space (MB) for closed sessions per workspace; the oldest are dropped first. The running session never counts.
cfg.codeLens: Show Accept / Discard / Diff actions above each changed hunk in the editor.
cfg.decorations: Highlight changed lines in the editor.
